newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha ends steady but lacking liquidity.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha ends steady but lacking liquidity.

text.p: NWE spot naphtha prices ended steady to firmer on Friday but any upside was mainly on the back of firmer crude with an industry conference taking many players away from their desks and leaving the market illiquid, traders said.

A Russian cargo meeting Dow spec reported offered into Rotterdam at around $172 a tonne set the spot market steady, but swaps were slightly softer around $173/$174 reflecting longer-term weaker sentiment with healthy supplies expected to restrict end-user demand to a hand-to-mouth basis.
However, traders said the lack of liquidity made both spot and paper market direction very hard to judge.
"I'd like it a bit higher with crude, but there's just no liquidity out there to push it up," one trader said.
